correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all inputs S_n with no 11, all DISTINCT one-coordinate deletion shadows, including endpoint positions and possible outputs with 11. Source artifacts/certificates.json provides every short code, n<=5 transversal, n6/n7 exact rational primal/dual pair at 4 and 6, and weighted conflict cliques totaling 15/4 and 23/4 that cover each eligible input. Independently verified all seven explicit certificate instances in integer-scaled rational arithmetic: all constraints, every clique pairwise shadow intersection, every cover weight, disjoint code shadows, and exact totals. Thus A_6<=floor(15/4)=3 and A_7<=floor(23/4)=5 while exhibited codes attain; fractional strong duality from matching primal/dual certs. Separately calculated all seven integer and LP optima via independent scipy optimization, matching all profiles. Proof is genuinely complete finite certificates, not only solver log.
